tier: Tier 4: Benchmark Safe Control / True Negative
primary_indication: Temporary relief of mild-to-moderate pain and fever reduction
known_critical_risks: First-line analgesic/antipyretic in all trimesters of pregnancy
Boxed warning: Acute liver failure with overdose (> 4,000 mg/day adult max; 3,000 mg in hepatic/chronic alcohol use)
Pediatric weight-based dosing: 10-15 mg/kg every 4-6 hours

patient_safety_guardrails.warnings_and_precautions:
### Sore throat warning
If sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.
